description: Event catalogue for the Annual PRA Stress Test journey. Introduces 2 events: EVT-161 and EVT-162. Both events published by SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004).

events.name: StressTestExerciseStarted
events.trigger: CRO triggers stress test exercise and PRA scenarios are loaded into risk engine. StressTestExercise created with status = in_progress.

consumers.action: Create RegulatorySubmission tracking record (ENT-074) for this stress test exercise.
Write immutable stress test exercise start record.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-exercise ordering via exercise_id partition key on topic risk.stress-testing.
events.worm_rationale: Stress test exercise start with PRA scenario version is a regulatory audit record — immutable for PRA supervisory review.

events.name: StressTestSubmitted
events.trigger: CRO confirms PRA submission via BEEDS portal. StressTestExercise updated with pra_submission_ref and status = submitted.

consumers.action: Update RegulatorySubmission status = submitted; record pra_submission_ref and submitted_at.
Write immutable PRA submission record with submission reference and stressed CET1 trajectory.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-exercise ordering. StressTestSubmitted must follow StressTestExerciseStarted for same exercise_id.
events.worm_rationale: PRA submission record with stressed capital ratios and submission reference is a regulatory audit record — immutable.
